2608.03740.title: MissClick: Exploiting Digit-Serialized Coordinates to Attack GUI Grounding Models
2608.03740.paper_summary: Recent GUI visual grounding models generate screen coordinates as sequences of digit tokens that are parsed into numerical values and mapped to executable clicks. The security implications of this coordinate generation process have been largely overlooked. We observe that each coordinate digit is predicted as a categorical token, yet after parsing, changing a hundreds-place digit by one changes the corresponding numerical coordinate component by 100 units, which can induce a large displacement of the executed click. This observation motivates attack objectives that account for the numerical and place-value structure of coordinate outputs rather than treating them as ordinary text. Moreover, untargeted and targeted attacks impose different success conditions--displacing the click outside the correct region versus into an attacker-specified region--and therefore benefit from different objectives. We propose MissClick, a simple and effective white-box adversarial attack with two goal-specific objectives: MissClick-U maximizes soft-coordinate displacement for untargeted disruption, while MissClick-T minimizes a place-weighted target-digit loss for targeted hijacking. Compared with existing attacks against GUI grounding models on OS-Atlas and UGround across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, MissClick-U achieves untargeted success rates of 75.07\% and 72.93\% (+16.62 and +30.72 pp), and MissClick-T achieves targeted success rates of 44.86\% and 62.67\% (+31.73 and +47.06 pp). Attack objective comparison further shows that soft-coordinate displacement yields the highest untargeted attack success rate, whereas place-weighted target-digit optimization yields the highest targeted attack success rate, revealing distinct objective preferences for the two attack goals.
2608.03740.paper_summary_zh: 最近的GUI視覺定位模型生成的螢幕座標是以數字標記的序列形式呈現，這些序列被解析為數值並映射到可執行的點擊上。這一座標生成過程的安全隱患在很大程度上被忽視了。我們觀察到每個座標數字都是作為類別標記來預測的，但在解析後，改變一個百位數字一個單位會使相應的數值座標組件改變100個單位，這可能導致執行的點擊位置產生較大位移。這一觀察促使我們提出攻擊目標，考慮座標輸出的數值和位值結構，而不是將其視為普通文本。此外，無目標攻擊和有目標攻擊施加不同的成功條件——將點擊位移到正確區域外與移動到攻擊者指定的區域——因此受益於不同的目標。我們提出了MissClick，一種簡單而有效的白盒對抗攻擊，具有兩個目標特定的目的：MissClick-U最大化無目標干擾的軟座標位移，而MissClick-T最小化有目標劫持的位權重目標數字損失。與針對OS-Atlas和UGround的現有攻擊相比，MissClick-U在桌面、網頁和移動平台上達到了75.07\%和72.93\%的無目標成功率（+16.62和+30.72個百分點），而MissClick-T達到了44.86\%和62.67\%的有目標成功率（+31.73和+47.06個百分點）。攻擊目標比較進一步顯示，軟座標位移產生了最高的無目標攻擊成功率，而位權重目標數字優化產生了最高的有目標攻擊成功率，揭示了這兩個攻擊目標的不同偏好。
